organizing_principle: operator succession rather than version chronology

operator_lineage.object: local move sequence and algebraic/state-equivalent shortening
operator_lineage.initial_appeal: A locally redundant route could appear to operationalize an unnecessary detour.
operator_lineage.court_result: Signal collapsed sharply as equivalence was restricted from broad algebraic/state redundancy toward irreducible/noncommuting primitive structure; the strict R5 definition was null and later prospectively replicated 0/888 in R1.8.
operator_lineage.lesson: Existence of a shorter/equivalent local move representation does not identify a cognitive detour.

operator_lineage.object: distance of intermediate full cube state from annotated phase endpoint
operator_lineage.initial_appeal: Moving away from a phase endpoint before returning could appear to identify recovery or correction.
operator_lineage.court_result: Raw pre-endpoint reversal was common (~63.8%); the preregistered max-excursion null was statistic-mismatched and over-conservative; a matched posthoc tail (~4.36% standardized) did not exceed the calibration familywise null (~5.96%).
operator_lineage.lesson: Temporary increase in full-state endpoint distance is ordinary algorithm geometry, not evidence of cognitive recovery.

operator_lineage.object: phase-specific task-relevant cubies with irrelevant coordinates quotiented out
operator_lineage.initial_appeal: Subgoal measurement should ignore cube coordinates irrelevant to the current phase.
operator_lineage.court_result: Synthetic invariants passed and CFOP/ZB structural support was strong; directly attempt-level nested familywise calibration passed. Global future-score transport nevertheless failed its frozen 0.95 compatibility gate, localized mainly to Roux.
operator_lineage.lesson: A better geometric operator can still fail transport because method-specific semantics differ.

operator_lineage.object: CFOP/ZB-specific future-scale attempt statistic versus Roux block frame
operator_lineage.court_result: CFOP/ZB LAYERED transport passed prospectively (crossfit↔LOO r≈0.996, p99 difference≈0.122), releasing scorer engineering authority for later genuinely fresh CFOP/ZB; Roux center-canonical block frame failed.
operator_lineage.lesson: Transport authority belongs to a frozen method family, not automatically to a global scorer.

operator_lineage.object: Roux first/second block geometry with orientation-free frame and phase-line semantics
operator_lineage.court_result: Null engineering itself passed on 92 attempts, but frozen first-SB completion was 1/92 because SS was mistaken for completed SB; 69/92 orientation-free FB frames required center/color relabeling; N=92 could not resolve alpha=0.01.
operator_lineage.lesson: Annotation family membership is not phase completion, and orientation freedom is not automatically a physically persistent frame.

operator_lineage.object: per-state center-canonical physical frame plus state-defined first two-block completion
operator_lineage.court_result: Primary G2 admission collapsed to 10/130. A posthoc route-global diagnostic recovered 120/130, and FB-prefix-only gauge identification reproduced 120/130 without inspecting SB outcomes. Per-state center gauge changed across FB→SB in ~96.9% of routes.
operator_lineage.lesson: The reconstruction coordinate frame is a latent route-level gauge, not a statewise center reset.

operator_lineage.object: FB-prefix-only unique gauge with explicit x/y/z group-action transport
operator_lineage.court_result: Rotation algebra fixtures passed; prefix gauge was unique on 130/130 and completion on 120/130. However the targeted rotation-present stratum was only 3/6 against a frozen 0.75 gate. Wide/slice center-cocycle generalization was strongly rejected (30/130, losing 91 prior successes). The 120-route null bank achieved 1% resolution.
operator_lineage.lesson: A mathematically valid transport rule does not by itself define the right method ontology.

operator_lineage.object: state-derived CANONICAL_FB_PRESERVING versus explicit residual forks under the frozen prefix gauge
operator_lineage.court_result: Development: 114 canonical / 12 block-disruptive / 4 preserved-no-completion among 130 eligible. Canonical-only 114-attempt null retained zero fallback and 1% add-one resolution. Preexisting-unseen holdout: 117 eligible, 116 prefix-unique, 105 canonical (89.74%), with zero reference contamination and zero local fallback. Post-freeze genuinely fresh Roux routes: 0.
operator_lineage.lesson: A method-specific observable ontology can transport outside its development corpus while still withholding future authority until genuinely post-freeze evidence exists.

compressed_epistemic_ratchet: mathematically valid gauge transport != sufficient method ontology

current_claim_boundary.strongest_supported: CUBE-REV demonstrates, in a public speedcubing reconstruction case study, that behavioral traces require validated observation operators; multiple plausible operators failed falsification or transport courts, while the later G4 Roux ontology transported to a preexisting unseen route set under a frozen reference null.
not_supported: prevalence of cognitive recovery or cognitive error
